recipe.title: Oaty carrot hotcakes
recipe.notes: This recipe is from Nadia Lim's book, 'Yum!'

i.n: butter or coconut oil, for frying

method.s: Put all ingredients (except butter or coconut oil) into a blender or food processor and blitz until smooth.
Leave mixture on bench for 5-10 minutes to thicken a little.
Cook hotcakes in batches, using a little butter or coconut oil, for about 2 minutes each side until set and light golden.
Transfer to a wire cooling rack, then serve with yoghurt.
